overloadMerges.note: The doc syntax line has no parenthesized parameter list ('Windows Alt down : Boolean'), so the mechanical parser produced an empty overload with no return type at all; added the documented Boolean return type.
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns True if the Windows Alt key (Option key on Macintosh) is currently pressed.

constraints: On Macintosh, tests the Option key rather than a literal Alt key.
